card.name: Before/after introducing a bad outcome
card.fires_on: The words "before" or "after" (after "until") that begin a clause naming a looming harm or disaster, following talk of acting, warning or a problem.

modes.label: Act before harm
modes.description: "Before" follows a call to act or fix something, introducing the disaster to be avoided.
modes.example: Scientist have been scrambling to figure out why the colonies are collapsing<< before>> financial and economic disaster strike.

modes.label: Until after injury
modes.description: "After" follows "may not appear until", introducing damage already done.
modes.example: Patients and physicians should be aware, however, that oligohydramnios may not appear until<< after>> the fetus has sustained irreversible injury.

card.writes: It seems to prepare a clause describing a harmful event or condition, though the promoted tokens are unclear.
card.plain: It fires on "before" or "after" when what follows is a bad outcome that should be prevented or that has already happened.
evidence: She says urgent action is needed to help these people<< before>> winter.
oligohydramnios may not appear until<< after>> the fetus has sustained irreversible injury
